cases.brief: Read plugins/migration-refactor/paths/migration-batch-loop.json and plugins/migration-refactor/prompts/codex-migration-diff-audit.md from the repository. Audit whether the stop_conditions declared in the path JSON are fully reflected in the prompt instructions. Flag any stop condition that the prompt does not instruct the runner to check. Flag any prompt instruction that has no corresponding stop condition or path step. Output JSON findings only.

Read plugins/migration-refactor/sources/internal-migration-practice.md and references/execution-loop.md from the repository. Audit whether the migration playbook's batch-loop design (worktree isolation, regression gate, merge conflict stop, artifact evidence requirement) is consistent with the primitives described in execution-loop.md. Flag any claim in the playbook that contradicts or is unsupported by the execution-loop primitives. Flag any execution-loop primitive referenced in the playbook that does not exist in execution-loop.md. Output JSON findings only.

Read plugins/migration-refactor/plugin.json, plugins/migration-refactor/paths/migration-batch-loop.json, plugins/migration-refactor/profiles/codex-migration-diff-audit-v1.json, and plugins/migration-refactor/profiles/claude-semantic-equivalence-v1.json from the repository. Verify: (1) every profile id referenced in the path JSON matches a profile file declared in plugin.json provides.profiles; (2) every prompt_suffix_ref and output_schema_ref in each profile points to a file declared in plugin.json provides or exists under the plugin directory; (3) security.max_sandbox is read-only and no profile grants write permission. Flag any inconsistency. Output JSON findings only.
